checks.text: The page displays the heading "Daily Planner" and shows a tab labelled "Tasks" and a tab labelled "Calendar".
On the "Tasks" tab, typing "Buy milk" in the input labelled "New task" and pressing Enter adds a checklist item with the text "Buy milk" and a progress indicator showing "0/1".
On the "Tasks" tab, clicking the checkbox next to the item "Buy milk" changes the progress indicator to "1/1" and strikes through the text "Buy milk".
On the "Tasks" tab, clicking the button labelled "Delete Buy milk" removes the item "Buy milk" from the list and the progress indicator disappears.

On the "Calendar" tab, clicking the button "Add event" opens a form. Filling the field labelled "Title" with "Team Sync", the field labelled "Date" with "2023-10-25", and the field labelled "Time" with "14:00", then clicking "Save", adds an event to the month view for October 25, 2023, displaying "Team Sync" at "14:00".
On the "Calendar" tab, clicking the tab labelled "Week" switches the view to a week grid. The event "Team Sync" appears in the column for Wednesday, October 25, 2023.
On the "Calendar" tab, clicking the button "Export ICS" copies a text string to the clipboard that contains "BEGIN:VEVENT" and "SUMMARY:Team Sync".

On the "Calendar" tab, clicking the event "Team Sync" opens a detail panel. Changing the field labelled "Recurrence" to "Daily" and clicking "Save" adds a new event "Team Sync" to the month view for October 26, 2023.
Reload keeps the task "Buy milk" in the checklist with the text "Buy milk" and the event "Team Sync" visible in the month view for October 25, 2023.
